Join 300,000 learners from 81+ government partners. Grow your skills and serve the public better with InnovateUS.

 

InnovateUS provides no-cost at-your-own-pace and live learning on data, digital, innovation, and AI skills for public service professionals like you. 

 

Governed by a coalition of public sector learning and innovation leaders across the United States, our programs give you the skills to deliver more effective, equitable and engaged policies and services.

 

InnovateUS is brought to you by a team at The Governance Lab. We maintain full and sole control over writing, editing, and creation of InnovateUS course and workshop content, without influence from our generous funders.

Our learning resources are for public service professionals by public service professionals and emphasize evidence-based, participatory, and collaborative approaches.

 

We offer free:

  • At-your-own-pace courses on the critical digital, data, and innovation skills you need to be a 21st-century public service professional
  • Live, online, interactive workshops with leading practitioners
  • Customized and in-depth online coaching programs to help you apply new ways of working to your projects and programs

We believe that skill-building for those in government accelerates better outcomes for the public. However, a transition to new ways of working–effectively using data and community wisdom–will not happen on its own.

• Inputs: High quality, high production value content and platform to deliver free, at-your-own-pace and live training and coaching in new ways of working
  • Outcomes: Public servants equipped with skills to use new technologies who are more entrepreneurial, agile, and able to responsibly engage with residents and data, and thereby deliver policies and services more effectively and legitimately
  • Impacts: More effective and equitable resident-citizen services, happier public servants, better implementation of policy. Ultimately, restore trust in government, and deepen democracy

Governments’ success depends on the skills and knowledge of the people it employs.

 

Our work aims to boost the effectiveness and equity of government service delivery and policymaking, enhance trust in government, and create new opportunities for people, especially marginalized communities, to directly engage government.

 

For us, “new” ways of working include more open, participatory, and collaborative approaches that improve upon the “old” way of doing things, namely behind closed doors, without sufficient evidence, absent community participation, and without regard for the needs of systematically disenfranchised communities.

InnovateUS offered a cohort learning program led by Steve Kadish, former Chief of Staff to former Massachusetts Governor Charlie Baker. This program was for leaders and managers who want to tackle issues not just from a policy perspective, but also to gain a better understanding of how to execute change and deliver results—and have a proven method to do so—tailored to the public sector.

 

The program consisted of three 90-minute virtual lessons, followed by individual private consultation sessions with Kadish in the weeks following the workshops.

This program was free for participants.

 

Participants received a certificate of completion from InnovateUS following completion of the course.
